definition: Funding source that supplied the record.
transformation: Standardized from the corresponding source field.

definition: Globally unique source-prefixed grant identifier.
transformation: CORDIS_ or NSF_ prefix added to the source identifier.

definition: Original award or project identifier from the source.
transformation: Standardized from the corresponding source field.

definition: Title of the funded award or project.
transformation: Standardized from the corresponding source field.

definition: Main descriptive text for the funded activity.
transformation: CORDIS objective and NSF abstract mapped to one field.

definition: Start date of the funded activity.
transformation: Parsed to datetime using source-specific ISO formats.

definition: End date of the funded activity.
transformation: Parsed to datetime using source-specific ISO formats.

definition: Calendar year in which the funded activity began.
transformation: Derived from the standardized start date.

definition: Primary funding amount in the source currency.
transformation: CORDIS uses ecMaxContribution; NSF uses estimatedTotalAmt.
limitations: EUR and USD values must not be summed or directly compared without an exchange-rate method.

definition: Total project cost reported by CORDIS.
transformation: Standardized from the corresponding source field.
limitations: CORDIS totalCost is incomplete or inconsistent for some projects and is not used as the primary award amount.

definition: Funding formally obligated to date by NSF.
transformation: Standardized from the corresponding source field.
limitations: Represents committed NSF funding, not necessarily the final estimated award value.

definition: Native currency of the primary funding amount.
transformation: Assigned as EUR for CORDIS and retained as USD for NSF.

definition: Lead, coordinating, or recipient organisation.
transformation: Standardized from the corresponding source field.

definition: City of the lead or recipient organisation.
transformation: Standardized from the corresponding source field.

definition: Country or country code reported by the source.
transformation: Standardized from the corresponding source field.
limitations: Country representation follows source reporting and may use country codes rather than full names.

definition: Funding programme, call topic, or programme label.
transformation: CORDIS uses call_topic_title; NSF uses programme_name.

definition: Source-specific funding scheme or mechanism.
transformation: Standardized from the corresponding source field.
limitations: No directly comparable NSF field was available.

definition: Source-reported or derived award status.
transformation: CORDIS retains source status; NSF Boolean status mapped to ACTIVE or INACTIVE.

definition: Standardized activity category where available.
transformation: Standardized from the corresponding source field.
limitations: CORDIS nature was missing for all candidate projects.

definition: Original source-specific activity classification.
transformation: Standardized from the corresponding source field.
limitations: CORDIS nature was missing for all candidate projects.

definition: Link to the original award or project record.
transformation: Standardized from the corresponding source field.

definition: Core or broad AI–chemistry/materials relevance tier.
transformation: Standardized from the corresponding source field.

definition: Highest-priority taxonomy topic assigned to the grant.
transformation: Assigned using ordered rule-based keyword taxonomy.
limitations: Priority-based assignment; grants may legitimately match multiple topics.

definition: All named taxonomy topics matched by the grant.
transformation: Pipe-separated list of all rule-based topic matches.
limitations: Topic categories overlap, so counts across topics should not be added as unique-grant totals.

definition: Number of named taxonomy topics matched.
transformation: Count of named taxonomy topics matched by each grant.
limitations: A value of zero indicates the grant is retained in the fallback topic category.
